title: Query authoritative HDCP state through NVKMS
question: Can a community-built read-only bridge retrieve meaningful DP HDCP state from the shipping RM/GSP path?
acceptance_criteria: A truthful query preserves transport failure, detailed result, RM status, raw flags, and validity.
The implementation performs no control operation.
The default-off negative control emits no HDCP_PROBE record.
The enabled result is reproduced after at least two clean boots under direct DisplayPort SST topology.
The experiment yields one Gate 1 verdict with exact module identity and recovery evidence.
